title: Subject matter.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided in section 490:4A-108, this article applies to funds transfers defined in section 490:4A-104.
bodyHtml: §490:4A-102  Subject matter.  Except as otherwise provided in section 490:4A-108, this article applies to funds transfers defined in section 490:4A-104. [L 1991, c 41, pt of §1]
